data_scientist.headline: Moved across from research, two years in
data_scientist.why: A thin data-science history carried by projects and a quantitative PhD. Notice the order: the projects section sits above employment, because at this stage the work you chose to do says more than the job you happened to hold.

data.title: Data Scientist
data.summary:

data_scientist.headline: Four years, product data science
data_scientist.why: Every bullet names the decision the work changed, not the technique used. Experiment design leads, because product data science is judged on whether you can tell a real effect from a wishful one.

data.title: Data Scientist
data.summary:
- Product data scientist, four years across marketplace and subscription businesses.
- Runs the experiment programme end to end: design, power, readout, and the argument with the PM when the result is flat.
data.skills:
Experimentation: A/B and switchback design, sequential testing, CUPED, power analysis
Languages: Python, SQL, some Scala
Modelling: scikit-learn, uplift modelling, causal inference (DiD, synthetic control)
Stack: Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, Looker, Amplitude
data.experience:
Data Scientist | Rowan Marketplace | Manchester, UK | Mar 2023 - Present
- Rebuilt the experiment readout so results account for repeat buyers; three past "wins" turned out to be noise, and the roadmap changed accordingly.
- Designed the switchback test for same-day delivery pricing, which found a 4.2% margin gain that a naive A/B had shown as flat.
- Built the seller-churn model that now triggers account-manager outreach; retained sellers worth £2.1m GMV in its first year.
- Cut the time from experiment stop to readout from nine days to under one by templating the analysis.
---
Data Scientist | Northgate Media | Leeds, UK | Jul 2021 - Feb 2023
- Owned the subscriber propensity model behind the winback campaign, lifting reactivation 12% on a £3m spend.
- Found and fixed a tracking bug that had been inflating trial conversion by a third for two quarters.
- Ran the weekly metrics review with product and finance.
data.education: BSc, Mathematics and Statistics (First Class) | University of Sheffield | Sep 2018 - Jun 2021

data_scientist.headline: Nine years, now leading a team
data_scientist.why: The tooling list shrinks and the scope grows. At this level a recruiter is reading for what you were trusted with and what changed because of you — so the bullets are about teams, decisions and money, and the modelling detail moves to a supporting line.

data.title: Principal Data Scientist
data.summary:
- Principal data scientist, nine years in lending and payments; currently leads a team of seven across risk and pricing models.
- Took the credit-decisioning stack from a quarterly manual refresh to weekly automated retraining, under FCA model-governance rules.
data.skills:
Leadership: team of 7, hiring, model governance, regulator-facing documentation
Domain: credit risk, pricing, fraud, PD/LGD, affordability
Technical: Python, SQL, Spark, MLflow, AWS; XGBoost, GLMs, monotonic constraints for explainability
data.experience:
Principal Data Scientist | Meridian Payments | London, UK | Jan 2022 - Present

- Rebuilt credit decisioning on monotonic gradient boosting, improving Gini from 0.58 to 0.67 while keeping every feature explainable to the regulator.
- Moved model retraining from a quarterly manual exercise to a governed weekly pipeline, cutting the lag between a market shift and a live model from months to days.
- Chair the model risk committee; wrote the documentation standard the second-line reviewers now use.
